skills.name: Basic
skills.desc: Deals 120% ATK DMG to a single target.

skills.name: Ultimate
skills.desc: Deals a 4-hit combo to all enemies in a row, dealing a total of 12000% ATK shareable [Specialized Direct DMG] (only affected by advanced damage modifiers). Ignores 45% [Specialized Evasion] and [Non-Crit DMG Reduction], and pierces [Unyielding] and [Specialized Unyielding]. This DMG will not be shared with targets that cannot take DMG. For each valid target that can share the DMG, the total DMG is increased by 30%.

skills.name: Ultra-Ultimate
skills.desc: Deals a 4-hit combo to all enemies in a row, dealing a total of 15000% ATK shareable [Specialized Direct DMG] (only affected by advanced damage modifiers). Ignores 60% [Specialized Evasion] and [Non-Crit DMG Reduction], and pierces [Unyielding] and [Specialized Unyielding]. This DMG will not be shared with targets that cannot take DMG. For each valid target that can share the DMG, the total DMG is increased by 40%. Gains 25% [Armor Penetration].

skills.name: Passive
skills.desc: At battle start, gains 60% [Specialized Evasion]. On entry, reduces all enemies’ [Rebirth] count by 2 and reduces [Non-Crit Undying] duration by 4 turns. Also reduces all enemies’ [Revenge] and [Regroup] duration by 5 turns.

skills.name: Extreme Passive
skills.desc: At battle start, gains 70% [Specialized Evasion]. On entry, reduces all enemies’ [Rebirth] count by 3 and reduces [Non-Crit Undying] duration by 5 turns. Also reduces all enemies’ [Revenge] and [Regroup] duration by 5 turns.

skills.name: 5★ Passive
skills.desc: At battle start, gains 80% [Specialized Evasion]. On entry, reduces all enemies’ [Rebirth] count by 3 and reduces [Non-Crit Undying] duration by 5 turns. Also reduces all enemies’ [Revenge] and [Regroup] duration by 7 turns.

skills.name: Awaken 1 Passive
skills.desc: When G5’s own HP or [Specialized HP] takes DMG, permanently reduces the DMG taken by 60% and converts 60% of the original DMG into [Energy Shield]. Before any character takes action, G5 has a 40% chance to perform a [Charge Pursuit] at 80% skill power (will not trigger if there are no valid targets). Can trigger up to 2 times per turn. Each time an enemy is defeated, the follow-up chance increases by an additional 40%. [Charge Pursuit]: Uses a DMG-type or AoE healing Ultimate as a follow-up. Targets are random and it does not consume Energy.

skills.name: Awaken 2 Passive
skills.desc: When G5’s own HP or [Specialized HP] takes DMG, permanently reduces the DMG taken by 80% and converts 80% of the original DMG into [Energy Shield]. Before any character takes action, G5 has a 60% chance to perform a [Charge Pursuit] at 100% skill power (will not trigger if there are no valid targets). Can trigger up to 3 times per turn. Each time an enemy is defeated, the follow-up chance increases by an additional 40%. [Charge Pursuit]: Uses a DMG-type or AoE healing Ultimate as a follow-up. Targets are random and it does not consume Energy.
